name: ab-domain-research
description: Domain-research agent brigade — the FILL brigade that stocks a knowledge cellar with domain competency and gold exemplars for generative-skill builds: mise (readiness gate incl. the CELLAR_ROOT landing-target check), expo (composing coordinator for domain-fill orders), service — over 6 eval-proven stations: cert-body-sourcing (+0.60), standards-regulatory-sourcing (+1.00), academic-ocw-sourcing (+0.60, CC-licensed-only), public-filings-exemplars (+0.40-0.60, EDGAR/SAM.gov/courts/patents/GAO gold exemplars), award-case-study-exemplars (+0.60, juried-award libraries), freshness-watch (99% per-element — primary-source re-verification of landed grounding, routes factory refire tickets). Every station enforces license-gate-before-content, authority tiering, per-source dispositions, provenance frontmatter, untrusted-data discipline. Includes a packaged tasting set. Curation, never bulk scraping. Eval reports in evals/.
